description: This file contains API functions for an educational module within a larger ERP system, providing features such as course retrieval, student enrollment, attendance management, fee processing, assessment handling, and related API endpoints.

methods.name: get_course(program)
methods.description: Returns a list of courses associated with a specified program.

methods.name: enroll_student(source_name)
methods.description: Creates a student record from an applicant and enrolls them in a program, returning the enrollment record.

methods.name: check_attendance_records_exist(course_schedule=None, student_group=None, date=None)
methods.description: Checks whether attendance records exist for a given course schedule or student group on a specific date.

methods.name: mark_attendance(students_present, students_absent, course_schedule=None, student_group=None, date=None)
methods.description: Marks attendance for a list of students as present or absent for a specific schedule or group.

methods.name: make_attendance_records(student, student_name, status, course_schedule=None, student_group=None, date=None)
methods.description: Creates or updates an individual attendance record for a student.

methods.name: get_student_guardians(student)
methods.description: Retrieves guardians listed for a specific student.

methods.name: get_student_group_students(student_group, include_inactive=0)
methods.description: Retrieves students within a specified student group, optionally including inactive students.

methods.name: get_fee_structure(program, academic_term=None)
methods.description: Obtains the fee structure associated with a given program and academic term.

methods.name: get_fee_components(fee_structure)
methods.description: Retrieves fee components associated with a fee structure.

methods.name: get_fee_schedule(program, student_category=None)
methods.description: Provides fee schedule details for a program and optionally for a specific student category.

methods.name: collect_fees(fees, amt)
methods.description: Updates the paid and outstanding amounts for a fee record.

methods.name: get_course_schedule_events(start, end, filters=None)
methods.description: Fetches course schedule events within a specified date range for calendar display.

methods.name: get_assessment_criteria(course)
methods.description: Returns assessment criteria and their weightage for a specific course.

methods.name: get_assessment_students(assessment_plan, student_group)
methods.description: Gathers students in a group along with their assessment results.

methods.name: get_assessment_details(assessment_plan)
methods.description: Fetches assessment criteria and maximum scores for an assessment plan.

methods.name: get_result(student, assessment_plan)
methods.description: Retrieves a student's assessment result for a specific assessment plan.

methods.name: get_grade(grading_scale, percentage)
methods.description: Determines the grade for a student based on a grading scale and score percentage.

methods.name: mark_assessment_result(assessment_plan, scores)
methods.description: Records and saves assessment scores and calculates grades for a student.

methods.name: submit_assessment_results(assessment_plan, student_group)
methods.description: Submits assessment results for all students in a group for a certain plan.

methods.name: get_assessment_result_doc(student, assessment_plan)
methods.description: Fetches or creates a new assessment result document for a student.

methods.name: update_email_group(doctype, name)
methods.description: Creates/updates an email group from guardians of students in a group for communication.

methods.name: get_current_enrollment(student, academic_year=None)
methods.description: Fetches the current program enrollment record for a student in an academic year.
